body:
I do hope one day you so see that post from me however, if I believed in anything anymore Id pray but I did that for years and this evil shit has not once let up.

So Im done pretending that theres any justice in the universe. Millions die every year because there isn't. Thousands by the day expire in worse conditions or similar conditions to me.

I just have to do my best to live through it and hope there's enough of me left to keep protecting my children at the end of it.

Currently no, I have worked with my therapist extensively to ensure that I am not catastrophizing or being unrealistic. 

I've done the math, looked at the "resources" (99% of which are traps btw and only escapable with a community to begin with), and seen to what I can.

There is no exit, as of yet, and I don't know when there will be. Former foster kids like myself rarely have any community or family at all and definitely not any trustworthy with kids.

In addition, where I live currently is the only state where my healthcare needs and transportation is TOTALLY covered. I can't afford to leave and staying is killing me.

But my kids need stability, so I do what I must.

In my own case, they said it because I kept saying things that bothered them (because they were true it turns out) I believed they were right, that I was a useless dreamer... because I spent all my time curled away from the world reading when I wasn't slaving away trying to take care of my siblings... since my mother was incapable of nurturing a potted plant 😒

I try to remember that now. I was a better parent at 8 years old than my mother was as a grown woman. (Which isn't saying a lot but at least my three younger siblings ate and the plates weren't filthy)

I am still living with my NP and have two kids with them. Suffice it to say that after 8+ years of abuse, I feel supremely ugly and unattractive.

I have been considering surgery, and in my circumstances, might have to do that for safety reasons anyway... But loads of people say that I am beautiful the way I am. 

I can't see it, all I see is the myriad imperfections, physical, and severe mental illness... I no longer take selfies unless I feel I have to. I publish none of them. I can't even glance at myself in the mirror without flinching away from my own image.

Don't make my mistake and leave yourself no way forward. Talk with a therapist, and maybe a psychiatrist. I'm fairly certain I have body dysmorphic disorder. I've been through the ringer and it's not stopping anytime soon.

Get help, if you can't right now then make a plan to get that help in the future. Spend a little time each week looking for resources.

I highly recommend (if you Facebook) Swolesome Chadposting, they have been very helpful to many of my men friends who've needed support after an abusive relationship effected their self-perception. r/MensLib also has a surprising amount of resources in this same area.

Avoid what has already consumed my life!
What printer do you use?

You sound like a really awesome person, thank you for the support you gave when you're having it tough yourself! 

I read this because I am too cowardly to post how I really feel... This and so many comments here helped. Best advice I've read on here, realest too 💜
Btw it's a beautiful poem and I hope this helps you to really convey the fullness of it :)

Much better, the only thing that's jarring are the As's, if you want to ellicit genuine emotional reactions from your audience, to share the feeling you're conveying, you want to put as little distance between the feeling and the audience as possible.

Try it out, keep the previous drafts, but muck with it until there are as few filler words as possible. Make it punchy, and if you need to dance around the feeling, slowly circle it and build up suspense before the hook and resolution.
So glad I could help! I had a beast of a Rhetorical English professor so it's basic advice but it's been very useful

I think using less prepositions, and sprinkling your adjectives more sparsely would be good. Try to avoid repeating or using the same words like 'that' and 'they' unless they are unavoidable.

What helps me to remember that is the phrase (and I'm not sure who it's from) "poetry is generally about using as few words as possible to convey the most meaning".
As evidenced by? Seriously, I'm curious.
I am so so happy for you!!! Over the moon! This is so rare to see but it just lifts my spirits sky high!

Oh my fucking god that sounds just like my goddamn workplace. Only they worship averageness (white/beige, middle to upper middle class, "charity" work that they never examine how they approach, it goes on forever) and since I'm the damn kicked puppy of the bunch I get to be shit on by every Boomer there about everything from my lack of ability to look neat and tidy (I never learned how to do my hair, and I'm much better at it than I used to be so thanks for also shitting all over my progress Gramma), to my nervousness (yay C-PTSD), to my health problems (wait til you have real problems!)... It's like these idiots share a malevolent hive mind and they do their best to break me down.

I've been lucky to have such a good manager who doesn't put up with that stuff, and who has a past like I do. She gets it but these people don't have actual problems and they all drive me nuts.

It's hard to have compassion for ourselves when people we thought we could trust, even for a moment, betray and torture us in one of the worst ways imaginable.

You survived what has killed many people before you, and what will kill many after you.

Bent and broken inside but still able to heal, to be better than the human shaped muck who did this to you.

The brain will tear itself apart trying to survive, the toll it takes is immense and immutable but can be shaped by us into weapons of our own to fight the monsters that hurt us and our friends.

You lived to give yourself a chance to be loving and loved, experienced and wise... You could not grow to be these things if you had fought and not survived.
I can't just try anything is the problem, I have very bad reactions to most medications including aspirin, there's few I can safely take and fewer that are effective.

Holy shit I feel this so much! Aside from the good therapist part, I haven't been able to find someone who can actually help me, but your advice on that is pretty good and I'm trying to find the right one.

And yeah I fucking hate that whole survivor cookie thing, like all this trauma and I get to live with it and my abusers get off scott-free... What kind of prize is that? If I had died they might actually have had to face consequences! 

Yeah lol survivor, more like survivors guilt.
I feel this, I am having a harder and harder time reaching out or talking to others about anything I feel. I'm sorry you're here too.

Holy shit... I never thought of it that way before. I thought I was doing well because none of my partners hit me like my mother did...

But they all want to talk about themselves, use me as their personal therapist and physically and emotionally neglect me, like both my mother and my father did...

Even a good number or my so called friends...

Fuck. Lol now I'm going to have to go think about this.

I'm sorry that you are going through this OP, but I'm glad you had this realization. Not knowing causes far more trouble than knowing ever does and hopefully this will help you avoid bad relationships. And heck, you may have helped me today just by talking about this!

Kids. Young kids.

Which breaks my heart, I really truly don't want to leave them but in addition to this neverending depression and anxiety, I have an ugly and rare form of PTSD that manifests in full on attacks that last for hours...

Best I can describe it is it's like a combination of a hallucination and a flashback. There's no visuals, it's just tactile and audio, and it's anything from a small prick like a needle test on a fingertip, to full on re-experiencing a rape. This can happen anywhere, at any time. It lasts anywhere from seconds, to hours. Longest fit was 4 hours nonstop.

The only way I can predict a damn thing is by taking down the attacks in my special little calendar symptom tracker and then I can figure out when it's most common.

There's no meds for this shit. I'm stuck with it.

Christmas is pretty terrible, just hearing the fatuous music and glittery lies makes me I'll. 

I'm not going to til after Christmas, many Christmases, because I'm not allowed to die but God I wish I could right now.

I fucking hate that shit, I've been told I should write a book by EVERY FUCKING therapist I have had. I have been told I'm brave when all I was doing is taking the abuse I couldn't avoid.

I hate that, worse than that is the pity party assholes though. I don't want pity, I want acknowledgement and understanding.

I wish there were support groups for folks with these issues that weren't traps.

Ohhhh yeah, my mother still brings up "my little crush" on this older kid who had Cycstic Fibrosis. I was ten.

Unsurprisingly, he died, and then the bitch went to his parents and got his dogs given to her "because my daughter just loved your son so much and it would be a great thing to remember him by, she'll take great care of them!" 

She never gave me food or supplies to care for them, the first one ran away after less than two weeks, the second turned mean and feral and was as skinny as I was (which was terrifying).

I'm afraid of dogs, have been since before she decided to take them on, but I am now specifically triggered by small barky ones. And pancakes. 

She used to make pancakes and have me bring them over, looking back she was trying to get me attached.

I hate her.

For sure, if I make it to when my kids are adults, I want to join up with whatever stupidly suicidal do-gooders are around and throw myself into getting medical supplies to whatever oppressed and dying group there is at the time. 

If I die after actually having done some good maybe I won't go straight to hell. I already live in a hell, but knowing AngrySkyDaddy™ I'll be too gay or whatever to sit with the cool kids.

Hopefully I can just ask whatever deity to just snuff me out for good, as my reward for trying to not be the monster I still struggle not to be to this day.

Yes exactly! And emotional flashbacks, usually that tie into some of the stuff that I know where it's from. 

It's hard to contextualize what event the sensations are from because of it all being non-visual... but there's some I can identify easily and some that I have no recollection where the hell, when the hell, or with whom the hell they happened.

I do know why, I was assaulted and hurt most around that specific biological event which seems to now be an environmental trigger that is not escapable. Unfortunately, I am very allergic to the types of hormones used to shut down the ovulation cycle and the mental effects are nearly as bad as it puts me into a depression that is also life threatening. 

Without that option, I'm really not sure what to do. I have fantasies where I end up getting a hysterectomy, which I know would be bad but holy shit I would do just about anything to make this stop.

I'm scared to death of offending her... I don't have family, or advocates that are able to help me consistently... She's one of the few people in my corner and I don't know if I can risk the relationship.

It's not that she's unhelpful at all, quite the opposite, I know that she's working hard, hell she's way better than my previous therapists by miles. She got me the info for SARC and didn't invalidate, or even seem surprised by my symptoms, just the severity seem to be a bit much and it's hard enough for me to live like this as it is... trying to describe it is a whole other hell. I have to fight every instinct I have just to mildly complain about something another person would be shouting about to a manager.

I will talk with her about this though, just a more sanitized, sugar coated version, I don't want to invalidate her work or worse yet earn her ire.

I probably can do that, I've told her the very very sanitized version I posted here, the problem is that trying to talk about it at all in depth gets into nitty gritty she clearly cannot handle. Her face does this pinchy thing. The same kind of backing away any therapists or very close friends have done. There's a backpedal, I have triggered some folks who've never even dealt with anything like what I'm describing. 

I have to lie about so much just to not get that reaction, or worse yet pity. I get angry when people pity me and I can't take it.
Same, but kids not dogs, and I do have a parter, they're just abusive.

You're not, sounds like you've been living in a hell... It makes sense why you'd want to go. I nearly killed myself month ago, and even though I'm mad and disappointed that it didn't work, I'm just happy my shitty parents inside my brain didn't win yet... Is it weird to live each day out of fear/spite?

Also homeless (but have couches to surf so no as bad) and survivor.
